html:
A Vietnamese scholar, official and poet of the 18th century, often called the greatest encyclopedist of premodern Vietnam. He wrote on history, geography, government, literature and science.

He came from Thái Bình province and placed near the top of the court exams in 1752. He served the Lê court under the Trịnh lords, who held real power in the north of Đại Việt. In 1760 he went as envoy to Qing China, where he talked with Chinese scholars and Korean envoys and read new books, including some on European science brought by Jesuits.

His works include a history of the Lê dynasty and the Vân đài loại ngữ, a classified encyclopedia of knowledge. When Trịnh armies took the southern lands of the Nguyễn lords in 1775, he was sent to govern them, and he wrote the Phủ biên tạp lục, a detailed survey of their people, trade and taxes. It is a key source on the south just before the Tây Sơn wars. He was an older contemporary of the poet Nguyễn Du.
sum: A Vietnamese scholar, official and poet of the 18th century, often called the greatest encyclopedist of premodern Vietnam. He wrote on history, geography, government, literature and science.
